title: Count long-running TermAl terminal commands as writers for Engram test checks
outcome: TermAl terminal commands (run and stream) mark open Engram checks only as they start and as they end, so a check that starts and finishes while a long-running user terminal command (a watcher, a dev server) is in flight is never marked overlapped. Keep an in-flight host-writer count per worktree key (incremented at the first note_engram_host_write, decremented at the second) and treat a non-zero count as another writer when a check starts and finishes. Documented as a limitation. Raised by the Claude round-6 /review-code of tm-winf steps 2+3.
